newsitem.title: USA: CCC crop-loan interest rates set for April-USDA.
newsitem.headline: CCC crop-loan interest rates set for April-USDA.

text.p: U.S. Agriculture Department said Monday interest rates for CCC crop loans made during April would be 5.625 percent for 1995 and earlier crops and 6.625 percent for 1996 crops.
The rate for 1996 crops was down 0.125 percent from March while the rate for earlier crops was up 0.125 percent.

The 1996 farm policy law requires that interest rates on crop loans for 1996 and succeeding years be one percentage point higher than a formula in use in 1995. The requirement does not affect crops harvested in previous years.
